title: Get a first slug from one import and one call

fields.summary: As a developer trying slugkit for the first time, I want a slug from one import and one call, so that I stop getting `invalid options`.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [api-trace] state: a new Node project with only slugkit installed, importing slugify and calling `slugify('Hello World')` with no options; expected: it returns 'hello-world' after 1 import and 1 call
2. [api-trace] state: the same new project calling `slugify('Hello World')` with no options; expected: the words are joined by a dash, the result is all lowercase, and it is not shortened (0 = no length limit)
3. [metric] state: the existing tests in test/index.test.js, which call createSlugger with all five options; expected: 0 failures, with 0 test files changed
4. [metric] state: README.md; expected: its first code example has 2 lines: the import of slugify and `slugify('Hello World')`
fields.scenario: In a new Node project with only slugkit installed, import slugify and call `slugify('Hello World')`; run the existing tests; read the README's first example.
fields.environment: a new Node project on linux with only slugkit installed; synthetic input only
fields.checkpoints:
1. `slugify('Hello World')` returns 'hello-world' from one import and one call, with the agreed defaults (criteria 1, 2)
2. Existing createSlugger users see no change (criterion 3)
3. The README opens with that two-line example (criterion 4)
fields.assumptions: - slugify is exported next to createSlugger from the same entry file.
fields.open_questions: - answered: whether createSlugger changes (no: it keeps working as today)
fields.parked_ideas: - option names: renaming options such as transliterate (the human parked it)
fields.provenance:
Request: "Make slugkit simple to use. People keep getting it wrong. It belongs under Feature #90 (Developer experience)."
Vague: "simple" → criteria 1, 2, 4
1. confirmed (simple.lib-surface/calls-to-first-result): "One import and one call: `slugify('Hello World')` should give 'hello-world'"; facts: export:slugkit
2. confirmed (simple.lib-surface/defaults): "Every option should be optional: a dash, lowercase, and no length limit unless you ask." / "`slugify('Hello World')` should give 'hello-world'"; facts: export:slugkit
3. confirmed (request/existing-behaviour): "Keep createSlugger working exactly as it does for people who already use it."; facts: test:test/index.test.js, export:slugkit
4. confirmed (simple.lib-surface/calls-to-first-result): "One import and one call: `slugify('Hello World')`" / "that should be the first example in the README"; facts: export:slugkit
